name: Walking lunge
notes: Bodyweight or loaded alternating lunge. Count total steps unless a routine specifies otherwise.

guide.setup: Stand tall with feet hip width, holding dumbbells at the sides if loaded, and brace before stepping.
guide.execution: Step forward and lower until both knees are near 90 degrees, then push through the front foot into the next step.
guide.cues: Stay tall. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes. Use a consistent stride.
guide.mistakes: Front knee collapsing inward; steps too short; pushing mainly from the back foot; rushing between steps.
